definitions.short: (absolutely) to create ; (qualified) to cut down (a wood), select , feed (as formative processes)
definitions.usage: choose, create (creator), cut down, dispatch, do, make (fat).
definitions.full: H1254. bara ' I. בָּרָא 53 verb shape, create (compare Arabic probably loan-word, form, fashion by cutting, shape out, pare a reed for writing, a stick for an arrow , but also , create ; Phoenician הברא CIS i. 347 incisor, a trade involving cutting ; Assyrian barû , make , create , COT Gloss & Hpt KAT 2Gloss 1 but dubious; Sabean ברא found, build , DHM ZMG 1883, 413, synonym בנה ; Ba ZA. 1888, 58 , compare Assyrian banû , create , beget , with change of liquid; Aramaic בְּרָא , , create ) — Qal Perfect Gen 1:1 19 t.; Imperfect יִבְרָא 1:21 , 27 ; Num 16:30 ; Infinitive בְּראֹ Gen 5:1 ; Imperative בְּרָא Psa 51:12 ; Participle בּוֺרֵא Isa 42:5 10 t.; suffix בֹּרַאֲךָ 43:1 ; בּוֺרְאֶיךָ Eccl 12:1 ; — shape, fashion, create , always of divine activity, with accusative of thing, seldom except in P and Isa 2 . 1 object heaven and earth Gen 1:1 ; 2:3 (P) Isa 45:18 (twice in verse); mankind Gen 1:27 (3 t. in verse); 5:1-2 ,(P) 6:7 (J) Deut 4:32 ; Psa 89:48 ; Isa 45:12 ; the host of heaven 40:26 ; heavens 42:5 ; ends of the earth 40:28 ; north and south Psa 89:13 ; wind Amos 4:13 ; the תנינים Gen 1:21 (P). 2 the individual man Mal 2:10 (|| father) Eccl 12:1 ; the smith and the waster Isa 54:16 (twice in verse); Israel as a nation 43:15 ; Jacob 43:1 ; the seed of Israel 43:7 . 3 new conditions and circumstances : righteousness and salvation Isa 45:8 ; darkness and evil 45:7 ; fruit of the lips 57:19 ; a new thing חֲדָשָׁה (a woman encompassing a man) Jer 31:22 ; בְּרִיאָה (swallowing up the Korahites) Num 16:30 (J); cloud and flame over Zion Isa 4:5 . 4 of transformations : a clean heart Psa 51:12 (|| חִדֵּשׁ ); new heaven and earth Isa 65:17 (in place of old); transformation of nature 41:20 ; with double accusative גילה ירושׁלם בורא transform Jerusalem into rejoicing 65:18 . Niph`al Perfect 2feminine singular נִבְרֵאתְ Ezekiel 21:35; 3 plural נִבְרְאוּ Exod 34:10 2 t.; Imperfect יִבָּרֵא֑וּן Psa 104:30 ; Infinitive suffix הִבָּרַאֲךָ Ezek 28:13 ; הִבָּֽרְאָךְ 28:15 ; הִבָּֽרְאָם Gen 2:4 ; 5:2 ; Participle נִבְרָא Psa 102:19 ; — Pass. 1 be created: heaven and earth Gen 2:4 (P); creatures Psa 104:30 ; mankind Gen 5:2 (P); heavens Psa 148:5 . 2 with reference to birth : נבראת אשׁר במקום in the place where thou wast created (i.e. native land) Ezekiel 21:35; הבראך יום day when thou wast created (king of Tyre) Ezek 28:13 , 15 (compare ילדתיך היום Psa 2:7 ); נִבְרָא עַם 102:19 (|| נוֺלָד עַם Psalm 22:32). 3 of something new, astonishing: miracles Exod 34:10 (J); new things, חדשׁות Isa 48:6 . Pi`el Perfect בֵּרֵאתָ Josh 17:15 ; בֵּרֵאתוֺ 17:18 ; Infinitive absolute בָּרֵא Ezek 21:24 (twice in verse); 23:47 ; — 1 cut down: a forest Josh 17:15 , 18 (J); בְּחַרְבוֺתָם אוֺתְהֶן וּבָרֵא Ezek 23:47 . 2 cut out: יָד hand, as an index Ezek 21:24 (twice in verse). II. [ בָּרָא ] verb be fat (Arabic be free of a thing, sound, healthy ; see מרא ) — Hiph`il Infinitive לְהַבְרִיאֲכֶם 1Sam 2:29 to make yourselves fat .
